items.headline: DiffuSpace open-sourced Clover, a diffusion coding model reporting 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified
items.excerpt: DiffuSpace released open weights for Clover-35B-A3B-Preview on 29 October, a diffusion language model that the team says scores 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified.

items.headline: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber defenders first, at 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro
items.excerpt: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on 28 October, scoring 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro by its own measure, and opened it first to a small group of cyber defenders.

items.headline: OpenAI says its models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis, with outside experts reviewing
items.excerpt: OpenAI announced on 26 October that its models produced three results in maths, computer science and physics, one of them a claim that the Exponential Time Hypothesis is false.

items.headline: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra at $1 per million input tokens, half its predecessor's price
items.excerpt: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on 26 October, priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens, half the price of GPT-5.6 Terra.

items.headline: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, fourth on the Artificial Analysis index
items.excerpt: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro on 23 October, and Artificial Analysis scores it 55 on its Intelligence Index, fourth overall.

items.headline: Canva released Craft, its first in-house image model, to all users
items.excerpt: Canva released Canva Craft on 22 October, its first image generation model built in-house, available to all users in the Dream Lab tab.
